scope: Independent static technical review of the isolated course engine against the Merzlyak baseline, state persistence and answer contracts, catalog filtering, reviewed-content gate, bundle build and offline packaging, and browser/CI check coverage. Focused pure-function regressions executed; no independent real-browser execution in this review.

resolvedFindings.finding: Equivalent authored numeric answers with spaces around punctuation were rejected.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Normalize whitespace only around arithmetic/list punctuation. Preserve whitespace between alphanumerics, including the space in mixed fractions. Tested nine equivalent/distinct pairs.

resolvedFindings.finding: Editing a previously successful final answer could leave the old success feedback visible.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Input now clears checked and successMode and replaces the feedback with an explicit recheck/save message. Successful-state restoration verifies the saved answer still matches.

resolvedFindings.finding: Bare topic search omitted exercises, A1 search could include A10, and Cyrillic б did not map to the Latin subpart alias.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Exact topic/level/number/part matching and symmetric Cyrillic query/index normalization. Regression checks cover 4.2, A1, Cyrillic А1б and level C1.

resolvedFindings.finding: General recheck wording was inappropriate for manually reviewed proofs.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Manual proof drafts are saved with distinct wording and explicitly require teacher discussion; no automatic correctness claim.

resolvedFindings.finding: The generic planar viewer instruction claimed numeric data were labelled on every drawing.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Course-local viewer wrapper says numbers and ratios are given in the problem statement.

resolvedFindings.finding: Generic final-answer prompts did not remind learners what quantity to enter.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Build prepends the authored goal to generic final prompts without mutating source answer objects.

resolvedFindings.finding: An arbitrary minimum explanation length rejected valid concise algebra such as 2x−x=x.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Schema retains nonempty justifications with an allowed kind; the course check rejects placeholders without an arbitrary character threshold.

resolvedFindings.finding: An earlier test comment overstated per-card answer/proof verification.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The comment now accurately distinguishes all-card retained-step journeys from representative exact-answer/manual-proof interaction scenarios.

verifiedProperties: Changes are isolated to the Shestakov course engine; baseline engine remains a comparison reference.

Per-lesson state keys include book id, lesson id and revision. Drafts, intermediate inputs, revealed steps, assistance, success history and camera are persisted. Stale-window writes are checked against the expected stored state; a conflict freezes edits and exposes recoverable old text.
Manual proof mode saves text without granting correctness. Exact mode compares authored accepted strings after limited normalization, with no expression evaluation.
Catalog filters reset pagination. Full source identities include section-qualified exercise numbers, so A1 in different sections remains distinct.

The builder only marks chapter content reviewed when the current chapter bytes match a passed review hash with reviewer/date. The runtime only opens validated, catalog-matching reviewed lessons and blocks draft/in-review or malformed material.
UI text uses the shared safe text renderer; inputs are not evaluated as JavaScript. Model/content identifiers reject reserved prototype names.

Offline packager inlines styles, shared scripts, course engine and JSON. It removes CSS imports and runtime fetch, escapes script termination in embedded scripts and less-than characters in embedded JSON, and retains intentional external navigation links.
The task view hides the generic introductory block via sy-lesson body class and restores it on catalog return.

The consultation workflow uses a fixed three-card input and explicit unavailable/failed/truncated outcomes. Its result is bounded consultation evidence, not an exhaustive content review or deployment approval.

limitations: This record does not assert that real-browser checks or a file:// offline smoke test were executed by this reviewer. Parent owns final browser evidence.
runtime-browser.cjs walks every card through all retained steps and checks mobile overflow. It submits answers/proofs in representative scenarios rather than every accepted spelling on every card.

Final content coverage, source accuracy, mathematics, screenshots, and chapter review hashes are covered by separate records; chapter-specific mathematical checks were rerun at the follow-up timestamp.
Exact-mode checking recognizes listed forms plus limited normalization; it is not a general symbolic equivalence engine.
No external request, publication, repository commit or deployment was performed by this reviewer.
